scenario: LIMP.4.1.1 — the expression-position qualifier rewrite descends every where-clause / let / kwarg expression of a whole-module-importing file to rewrite `<lib>.<name>` const refs. It must handle every Expression node, RegexMatch (`~`/`!~`), IntervalRel (`in`/`contains`/`overlaps`) and MethodCall among them. Pin: a whole-module import (qualified pattern refs `m.X`) whose rules use each of those node types in a where clause compiles cleanly. The MethodCall is `t.to_string("iso8601")` on a `Time` slot (a format, because the formatless spelling is the cast `t::String`), and the method is incidental to what this pins.
rules_ds:
import m

rule r_regex:
    m.Foo f where f.text ~ /hi/
->
    log info "x"

rule r_interval:
    m.Win w where w.probe in (w.lo .. w.hi)
->
    log info "x"

rule r_method:
    m.Ev e where e.seen.to_string("iso8601") == "x"
->
    log info "x"

libraries.m:
schema Foo scope logical:
    text: String key

schema Win scope logical:
    probe: Int key
    lo: Int mutable
    hi: Int mutable

schema Ev scope logical:
    id: Int key
    seen: Time mutable
